(1837) |synonyms_ref = }} '''''Dicliptera'''''Jussieu AL de (1807) ''Annales du Museum National d'Histoire Naturelle. Paris'' 9: 267. is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the [[Acanthus (plant)|bear's breeches]] family, [[Acanthaceae]]. It includes 223 species native to the tropics and subtropics worldwide. Well-known synonyms include ''Peristrophe'' and ''Dactylostegium''. == Host plant == ''Dicliptera''{{which|reason=do all species host this butterfly or just some?|date=November 2024}} functions as a host plant for the butterfly, ''[[Anartia fatima]]''.{{Cite journal|last=Silberglied|first=Robert E.|last2=Aiello|first2=Annette|author-link2=Annette Aiello|last3=Lamas|first3=Gerardo|title=Neotropical Butterflies of the Genus Anartia: Systematics, Life Histories and General Biology (Lepidoptera: Nymphalidae)|journal=Psyche: A Journal of Entomology|language=en|volume=86|issue=2–3|pages=219–260|doi=10.1155/1979/50172|issn=0033-2615|year=1979|doi-access=free}} ==Species== {{As of|2021|March}}, ''[[Plants of the World Online]]'' included the following species.{{Cite POWO | id=331554-2 |title=''Dicliptera'' Juss. |access-date = 7 March 2021}} {{div col|colwidth=20em}} * ''[[Dicliptera abuensis]]'' Blatt. * ''[[Dicliptera aculeata]]'' C.B.Clarke * ''[[Dicliptera acuminata]]'' (Ruiz & Pav.)
